name: git status
purpose: Check the current state of your working directory and staging area.
explanation: Shows which files are 'Untracked' (Git hasn't started following them yet), 'Modified' (tracked files with new changes), or staged for the next commit.
expectedOutput:
On branch main
Untracked files:
  notes.txt
whenToUse: Step 2 of the Git workflow — before staging or committing changes.
commonMistakes: Assuming untracked files are automatically included in the next commit.
